decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core offer, costs a distributor little to keep listed, and supports service and consumables revenue.
UV spot varnishing is distant from the core but was launched as a flagship enhancement line that needs more time to build sales, though it carries more risk than the core products.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular finishing systems and drives related machine sales at minimal extra cost.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship central to the firm's automation direction and will continue to be promoted.
The hybrid saddle stitcher serves the core booklet-making market for short-run digital printers.
